E7.description: The E7 engine (since the rules audit of 2026-09-30). The main players play each other and every newcomer 1,000 deals a side; greedy unless a player's id says otherwise. A newcomer rated near or above the top of the main set plays the strong tier only (leaderboard_play --strong; owner, 2026-10-16).

E8.description: The E8 engine: ENG-4 (2026-10-20: a draw that runs the deck out reshuffles there, inside Our Man in Tehran and Ask Not too) and ENG-5 (2026-10-22: the deal alternates, one card at a time, USSR first), the rules every E8 training run since ENG-5 plays. A player's name gives the engine its network was trained on; its games here are played under E8's rules, so E7 networks play on it unchanged. The anchor is E7's best player, the R34 soup under the corrected keyed root at 32 worlds, at 1600; the main set adds the A13 heads SWA. Greedy unless a player's id says otherwise.

also_accepts.why: The 2026-10-28 review fixes (engine/AGENTS.md section 15): only the runner section moves, because a US forced into DEFCON 1 off We Will Bury You's Ops is now recorded as provoked (its ending reason); no decision or result in the digest changed. The other changes -- We Will Bury You paying on an empty-handed or passed US round, a finished game's score no longer moving -- reach no digest game and were ruled too rare to matter (owner, 2026-10-29).

ENG-6 (engine/AGENTS.md section 16): a card played through a pushed frame -- Grain Sales fired by Star Wars, Five Year Plan or Missile Envy -- is now placed, owes its Event and leaves the stack. Games reaching that path do differ, which is why runner, rollout and mcts move, but it is rare; the owner ruled it too minor for a new epoch, changing E8's engine in place, and stored games no longer valid are discarded (owner, 2026-11-02).

ENG-7 on top of ENG-6 (engine/AGENTS.md section 17): Space Race box 6's end-of-turn discard no longer offers a held scoring card, which escaped the loss for holding one. E8's top network used it in 29 of 30 chances (0.73% of sampled self-play games), so runner and rollout move; the owner ruled it a fix in place, and stored games no longer valid are discarded (owner, 2026-11-04).
